name: Oil Rig Roughneck
perk_text: Rig hand: fixes overheating and dead batteries for free.
joke: Blew two weeks of hitch pay at the Wind River Casino in one night. All that's left is a buffet coupon and a $900 payment on a truck you already wrecked.

goal.title: Get back to the oil patch after losing your ass at the Wind River Casino

steps.task: Get back to the rig in the oil patch outside Evanston
steps.done: You roll into the patch outside Evanston with a casino players card and no money. The toolpusher asks how your days off went. 'Fine,' you tell a crew that has already seen the video.

goal.late: The rig gave your spot to a guy who doesn't gamble. Nobody likes him, but he showed up.

name: Jackson Hole Ski Bum
perk_text: Immaculate vibes: party mood drops half as fast.
joke: Came for the slopes, stayed for probation. Rents a gear closet for $1,400 a month and calls it a studio.

goal.title: Check in with your probation officer in Jackson

steps.task: Get your skis out of hock in Dubois
steps.done: The pawn guy hands over your skis and a look of deep concern. Now go see your probation officer.

steps.task: Check in with probation in Jackson
steps.done: You check in at Jackson wearing ski boots, your only closed-toe shoes. Your officer sighs and signs the form. Freedom.

goal.late: You miss your probation check-in. There is now a warrant with your nickname on it.

name: Gas Station Night Clerk
joke: You have seen things at 3 a.m. that would age a trooper. You sold most of them beef jerky.

goal.title: Spend your one week of PTO in Yellowstone

steps.done: Your {vehicle} wheezes into Yellowstone. Against all odds, and company policy, you are on vacation.

goal.late: Your week of PTO is gone. You are needed on the night shift.

name: Rodeo Clown
perk_text: Party mood drops half as fast.
joke: Professionally trampled. Your health insurance is a barrel and a positive attitude.

goal.title: Make your rodeo gig in Cody

steps.task: Get to the rodeo in Cody
steps.done: You roll into Cody, paint your face in the side mirror and get trampled right on schedule. Career: saved.

goal.late: The rodeo hired another clown. A worse one. It stings.

name: Newly Hired Teacher
joke: You own 400 glue sticks and no savings. The district hired you over the phone and has not asked follow-up questions.

goal.title: Start your new teaching job in Casper

steps.task: Get to your classroom in Casper
steps.done: You reach your Casper classroom to find 31 seventh graders. Suddenly the twitchy crystal salesman seems very reasonable.

goal.late: School started without you. A substitute for the substitute has your room.

name: NOLS Dropout
joke: Left the course early over 'creative differences' about showering. Owns one very expensive rope and no shoes that match.

goal.title: Round up your drum circle and summon the Groove Goddess of Gaia at Sinks Canyon

steps.task: Pick up your friend Juniper in Dubois
steps.done: Juniper climbs in smelling of patchouli and bear spray, carrying a djembe and zero dollars. Next: Moss.

steps.task: Pick up your friend Moss in Jackson
steps.done: Moss quits a job folding $90 flannel mid-shift and brings a didgeridoo that fits nowhere. It rides across everyone's laps. Next: Kestrel.

steps.task: Pick up your friend Kestrel in Pinedale
steps.done: Kestrel crawls out of a yurt, announces three days 'off grid' and asks for a phone charger. The circle is complete. Now get your drum.

steps.task: Dig your drum out of its hiding spot at South Pass City
steps.done: The drum is right where you left it, under a historically significant pile of nothing. To Sinks Canyon!

steps.task: Hold the full-moon drum circle at Sinks Canyon
steps.done: The full moon clears the canyon wall. Nobody can keep a beat. The river sinks into the rock in protest, and two hours later the Groove Goddess of Gaia surfaces at the Rise. She asks if anyone brought snacks.

goal.late: The full moon has come and gone. The Groove Goddess of Gaia has other circles to attend.

finale.won: The Groove Goddess of Gaia rises from the Rise, nodding along. She asks, again, about snacks.

name: Drunk Ranch Hand
perk_text: Rides Dolly: cheap to feed, grazes free in warm months, and no speed traps.
joke: Three DUIs, no license, one very patient horse. The judge said no motor vehicles. Dolly has no motor.

goal.title: Ride through your court-ordered fresh start to Ten Sleep

steps.done: The judge reads your file, looks out the window at Dolly and approves her as transportation. Now, your class.

steps.task: Sit through sobriety class in Thermopolis
steps.done: Eight hours of slides. You get the certificate. Dolly ate the sign-in sheet. Now go earn a paycheck.

steps.task: Report to the ranch outside Ten Sleep
steps.done: The foreman checks your certificate, then your breath, then your horse. Two out of three. You're hired.

goal.late: The ranch hired someone with a driver's license. Dolly refuses to discuss it.

name: Trustifarian
perk_text: Deep pockets and a van with a real bed. Pays 25% extra for anything artisanal, and forages badly.
joke: Private school, a stylist for the dreadlocks, and kids who now attend a $38,000-a-year academy with its own goat. Dad still says you're a loser.

goal.title: Make your Jackson Hole condo a home base your rich parents can't call a loser's

steps.task: Buy a vintage vinyl collection off a man in Thermopolis
steps.done: Four crates of vinyl, mostly polka. You call it 'deep cuts' and pay triple. Next: Cody.

steps.task: Win an antique hand drum at a Cody estate auction
steps.done: You outbid a museum with your mother's card. The drum is very old and slightly haunted. Home base awaits in Jackson.

steps.task: Unveil the condo and host a drum circle for your parents in Jackson
steps.done: Your parents arrive from the gated enclave their New York and California friends built. Records spin, the antique drum booms, and your father admits the condo is 'not nothing'.

goal.late: Your parents arrive to a condo full of unopened boxes. Dad offers you an internship.

finale.won: Your father is clapping off the beat. Your mother is crying. You are, officially, not a loser.
